name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the preceding conversation and context provided.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses how engaging and interesting the response is, considering its ability to maintain or enhance the conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in how it adds new ideas or perspectives to the dialogue.

name: Clarity
description: Measures how clear and understandable the response is, including proper grammar and coherence.

name: Continuity
description: Assesses how well the response flows from the previous statements and maintains the conversational thread.

name: Informational Value
description: Evaluates the amount of new information or interesting facts introduced in the response that enrich the conversation.
